narrative: A 19-year-old Syrian was detained in Libya in August 2021 after a failed attempt to reach Europe by sea. He was held in al-Zawiya prison, where detainees are beaten with sticks and water cannons and repeatedly humiliated, and where people are held for ransom or sold. In his first month there he witnessed a fellow Syrian detainee tortured to death: the man had urgently asked the prison administration to take him to hospital, and instead of helping him they beat him until he died. Like hundreds of other Syrians held in Libyan detention centers after being caught trying to cross the Mediterranean, he remained detained without trial and without any defined length of detention.
